note: Defects found AFTER the final set was first accessed (S7 rule: report, invalidate affected confirmatory results; corrected reruns are EXPLORATORY). No frozen artifact, model, feature, threshold, cap or scoring semantic was changed by any of them; they are all in the NEW final-scoring/reporting code written after the freeze.

defects.where: scripts/w2r1/final/gates.R (new K/DST gate code), first S4 scoring run
defects.defect: The cluster bootstrap for T2 clustered by season|week (5 giant clusters) instead of the preregistered team-week / the frozen S4 harness's game_id cluster.
defects.found: immediately after the first S4 gate table was printed (same session, before any other layer was scored)
verdict_unchanged_by_correction: every other S4 slot (identical pass/fail on every gate)
defects.treatment: S4.rogers-park.DST confirmatory result is INVALIDATED: reported as EXPLORATORY_PASS_NOT_CONFIRMATORY and NOT counted as SHADOW_QUALIFIED. The other slots' gate outcomes are identical under both cluster definitions and are retained, with this disclosure.

defects.defect: T9 (oracle sensitivity) was first reported NOT_COMPUTED and that string was (wrongly) accepted by the pass regex; the frozen harness computed the oracle for only 3 of 9 slots, and the first raw json was written before the oracle block ran.
defects.treatment: the oracle control (a harness-sensitivity check, not a candidate change) was computed for ALL regimes and the regex made strict; all 9 slots PASS T9; no gate outcome changed. Disclosed; verdicts unaffected.
defects.reruns: S4 final scorer executed 3 times (deterministic; identical component results each time)
